About me

Curiosity is
part of the craft.

I connect how things look with how they feel and work.

My background in Computer Science shapes the way I think about structure, systems and experiences. My work in visual design brings that thinking to identities, communication and the details people remember.

I notice everyday friction, question familiar approaches and prototype possibilities. Some ideas become visual stories. Others become experiments in making things work better.
